caption:
A form that ends with "we'll be in touch" loses leads before you ever pick up the phone.

Chili Piper studied 4 million form submissions. When a lead could book instantly right on the confirmation page, booking rates jumped from a 30% industry average to 66.7%.

Most businesses never test this. Only about 8% of B2B sites offer instant scheduling on their forms, per the same research.

The fix works just as well for a quote request as a demo request. The moment someone submits, hand them a live calendar instead of a promise to call back.

See it running on your own funnel. 14 days free.
